repos.description: Archon is a self-hosted workflow engine ("factory builder") for AI coding agents. Processes are written as YAML workflow graphs whose nodes are agent prompts, bash commands, scripts, loops, human-approval waits, or child workflows; Archon runs them through existing agent CLIs/SDKs such as Claude Code. Features queues and triggers that keep runs moving, attention items that pause a run only for decisions a human owns, per-run git worktree isolation, approval gates, full event logs, transcripts and cost tracking in a local database, and chat and code-host adapters. Ships a bundled SDLC workflow pack that takes an issue to a merged PR.

ECC (formerly everything-claude-code) by Affaan Mustafa — an "agent harness operating system" shipped as a Claude Code plugin. Bundles a large set of agents (planning, review, build repair, security, architecture, domain work), skills (TDD, research, security, docs, frontend, data, ML, operations), command shims, per-language rule sets, hooks and memory with session summaries, continuous learning and instincts, MCP configs, and AgentShield security scanning for prompts, hooks, MCP, permissions, and secrets. Adapters extend it to other agent harnesses; also includes long-form usage and security guides and example per-stack CLAUDE.md configurations.
